verdict.rationale: Raygun documents automatic grouping of errors by exception type, class name, method name and stack-trace location, which covers the fingerprinting half of the story. The evidence shows no way to customize grouping when it is wrong: the hasher-version setting only selects which built-in algorithm is used, and ignore rules are an adjacent triage control, not a grouping override. Missing for 10: custom grouping keys/fingerprints or merge/split of error groups, depth on how duplicates are collapsed at scale, independent corroboration of grouping accuracy.
